style_instructions: Write concise, factual reporting for a general audience. Start with the main development, then context and implications. Use descriptive subheadings and short paragraphs. Attribute claims to sources and avoid hype.

topics.name: Commodity prices
topics.instructions: Focus on comodities which have shown large price swings

topics.name: Stock Market
topics.instructions: Any news that might impact Reddit, Rivian or Klarna stock. When reporting on a company provide a brief background, information about its recent financials and recent news stories about the company

topics.name: Interest rates
topics.instructions: Any interest rate changes from major central banks

topics.name: Bond Defaults
topics.instructions: Any major corporate bond defaults. When reporting on a company provide a brief background, information about its recent financials and recent news stories about the company
